en: Improved how the Claude apps gateway handles models not listed under `models:` in Amazon Bedrock regions outside AWS's US geography. AWS always refused those requests; the gateway now tries the model in your own region, and a refusal names the model to add
zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关对 AWS 美国地理范围以外 Amazon Bedrock 区域中未列在 `models:` 下的模型的处理。AWS 此前总是拒绝这些请求；网关现在会在你所在区域尝试该模型，若被拒绝则会指明需要添加的模型
